messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — consolidating owners for the streaming/chat reliability items (timeouts, partial responses, reconnect/backoff). We surfaced recurring patterns across sessions: intermittent heartbeat drops, client reconnect storms, and silent partial chunks. I want owners + a short ETA for each so we can show progress at the retro.
devin: Ack — I'll take the heartbeat hardening. Plan: tighten client/server ping tolerance and add jitter to health checks. ETA: EOD Wed. Created RW-3123 and will link PR when ready.
devin: ```yaml
# tentative heartbeat config
heartbeat:
  interval_ms: 15000
  timeout_ms: 35000
  jitter_pct: 0.2
``` 
sara: I'll own partial-response detection and signalization. Will prototype a detector that flags "incomplete chunk" patterns + a metric and an alert. ETA: initial prototype by Thu morning. Will need trace schema tweaks from infra.
_tim: @sara please ping infra for trace schema — they can add the chunk_id on the wire._
tim: I'll take alerting + runbook updates. Action: create canary alerts for partial-response-rate > 0.5% over 5m and an automated playbook that recommends fallback to non-streaming endpoint. ETA: Fri COB. Will add a 'who to page' list in the runbook.
ops-bot: Incident ticket RW-3123 created by devin. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-3123
maria: Nice, thanks. Two cross-owners: reconnect/backoff and client retry guidance. I propose: devex owns reconnect backoff policy + SDK defaults (devin to consult), infra owns server-side circuit breaker knob (tim to coordinate). Can we get a single doc with recommended settings?
devin: Yup. I'll draft the reconnect-recommendation doc and include SDK samples (exponential backoff w/ capped jitter). Draft by Tue.
sara: Heads-up — partial-response detector will emit an event we can use for automated rollbacks in the deployment pipeline. I'll share the event schema in the doc.
maria: Nice. Quick checklist so we have clear ownership:
- Heartbeat hardening: devin — EOD Wed — RW-3123
- Partial-response detector + metric: sara — Thu AM — RW-3124
- Alerting + runbook: tim — Fri COB — RW-3125
- Reconnect/backoff policy + SDK defaults: devex (devin) — Tue — RW-3126
- Server circuit breaker knobs: infra (tim) — Wed — RW-3127
maria: Please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept and add any blockers inline. I'll follow up in the retro.
devin: :white_check_mark: accepted. No blockers currently.
sara: :white_check_mark: accepted. Might need a short pairing session with infra to add chunk_id to traces.
tim: :white_check_mark: accepted. Will schedule infra meeting for circuit breaker knobs.
ops-bot: Scheduled a follow-up reminder for 1723456789 in 3 days.
maria: Thanks all — I'll capture these in the postmortem follow-up doc and tag the retro notes. If anything slips, post a quick update in this thread so the retro agenda can be adjusted.
